Comerica Securities Inc decreased its stake in Intel Corp (INTC) by 7.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Comerica Securities Inc sold 8,617 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 111,479 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.15 million, down from 120,096 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Comerica Securities Inc who had been investing in Intel Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $258.35 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.26% or $0.69 $55.44. About 16.42M shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 44.65% uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.
